name: machi-4-capacity
semantic_meaning: Capacity Tier 2 derives SAFE planning envelopes for RAM, execution limits, per-device accelerator memory, and storage. Storage Sonar is included and does not run unless writes are explicitly bounded. Reported, proven, and SAFE stay distinct.

A.axis: host memory reserve and ordinary storage without Sonar

C.axis: bounded real sonar write and cleanup

D.axis: unified accelerator is not a VRAM pool
